name: lattice-gateway
description: Universal Extensible LLM Gateway and Harness Architecture

scripts.build: bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 ./bin/lattice.ts --outfile lattice.exe && bun -e "import * as fs from 'fs'; fs.copyFileSync('lattice.exe', 'bin/lattice.exe');"
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run check:dashboard && bun test tests/unit
